sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/369 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: place 369, grid 529 'Pike Lake Campground' and search/details for every unit, 2027-06-15; sample site on 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12, 2027-03-16, 2027-06-19; grids for 2026-11-17 to 2027-04-27; read 2026-10-31)

values.note: Every campsite is electric: $33 a night, the same on a Saturday (June 2027); off-peak (November 2026 to March 2027) $29. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-31.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all 79 Pike Lake Campground units, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Electric 33.00, Fee 6.50); site 35 on Sat 2027-06-19 (33.00), 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12 and 2027-03-16 (29.00), read 2026-10-31

hookups.source: ReserveOhio search/details (all 79 'Campsite Electric', Electricity Hookup '30', no water or sewer hookup on any) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/pike-lake-state-park-campground ('All electric sites'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: 79 electric sites with asphalt pads 25-55 ft long (13 pull-through, 66 back-in); every one takes a 23-ft rig.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/details (Pad Length / Maximum Camping Unit Length 25-55; PullInTypeName Back In 66, Pull Through 13; Pad Surface Asphalt), read 2026-10-31

values.note: The showerhouse is closed November 1 to April 15. Group camp latrines are in the campground; the camp store loans sporting equipment to campers.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/pike-lake-state-park-campground ('Showerhouse, latrines, dump station'; 'Camp store loans sporting equipment to campers.'; 'Off-peak Season: The showerhouse is closed November 1 to April 15.') + ReserveOhio details ('Distance to Drinking Water' < 50-100 yards), read 2026-10-31

values.note: In the winter camping season facilities may be limited.

season.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/pike-lake-state-park ('During the winter camping season, facilities may be limited.') + ReserveOhio search/grid 529 for 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12, 2027-03-16 (75-77 of 79 units free), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Reservations required, up to six months ahead online or at (866) 644-6727. Every site is web-bookable with a 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/pike-lake-state-park ('Reservations are required and can be made online or by calling (866) 644-6727') + campground page ('Reservations may be made up to 6 months in advance') + ReserveOhio search/details (AllowWebBooking true, MaxStay 14), read 2026-10-31

summary: Fees $33 confirmed, added the $29 off-peak rate. Added 30-amp electric (no water/sewer at sites), 79 sites to 55 ft (13 pull-through), showers/water/dump/camp store, year-round with winter sales, ReserveOhio deep link, 6-month window, reservations required, 14-night max. Pin fine: 174 m from the sites' centroid. Not stated: weekend minimum (left inherited).
